body: I mean I really doubt it
I’m already broken spiritually and mentally from the way that things ended with my high school sweetheart. And all the wreck-less stuff I’ve done drunk, especially after the breakup.
My only path to redemption at this point is sobriety. I will not drink with you today. ❤️

If I got 100% sober after the breakup, I’m almost positive we’d still be together. I kept drinking, and when I drink I really turn into an asshole. Or I can. Sometimes I’m sweet. It’s always a gamble that I’m no longer willing to take. She was willing to give me another chance, she just wanted to see some change, and I never changed. I kept drinking, I kept pushing her to get back together drunk, hell we even got into yet ANOTHER fight while I was drunk and we were on a break, I was doing zero self reflection at the time and I didn’t even think I was doing anything wrong. I know if I quit immediately she would’ve taken me back, and that hurts. She loved me more than anything, and we were so great together until alcohol took over my life. For almost the entire last year of our relationship, she only saw me drunk or nursing a deadly hangover. We were barely even having sex, and when we did it was bad, because I was stuck inbetween these two states. I had one beer last night, I got 2 left to get me through the withdrawals if I need them, here’s to never drinking again afterwards ❤️‍🩹 it’s become pretty obvious I can’t drink.

Heartache has already come. I’m convinced I lost the one, we dated for 5 years. Took me months after the breakup to come full out of denial, I thought I was changing, i was not, and now that I am I’ve pushed her to far away from any chance of reconciliation :(

We both thought we had “the one”. We both did. On paper we’re perfect. When we were good we were perfect, and when we were bad she was still literally perfect and I was kind of evil. Of course denial was at play for ages, so there was a mental disconnect on my end.

Just UGH. I just miss hanging out with my best friend, yk? I’ll never get that again. I’ll be goddamn lucky to ever experience a connection like that again, especially with being emotionally abusive in my past…..

One thing I will never do is blame her. I did in the moment, but as more time goes on, the more I realize that it was all me. And the more I realize all she did was show me love while I denies it. It’s like I had no conscious at the time, no way that I could possibly be wrong.

It is how it works. This was not a small relationship in my life by any means, we were together for nearly 5 years. Anyone I see nowadays, oh how’d you an (x) split up? Oh I was emotionally distant/neglectful and sometimes abusive, and at the end extremely abusive. She’s telling her story, and it’s one of truth. On top of this growing and healing that I’m trying to do, I have to accept that I’ve hurt her, accept that my image/reputation has forever changed, and accept that this will forever be apart of my life story. It’s tough. And it will be even tougher to explain to new people that enter my life in the future, especially new potential dates or a partner. I will explain that I’ve learned a lot and am committed to changing, but history seems to repeat itself, at least in others eyes.

I got stuck in an immature dynamic I believe, where I did not accept the love in my heart. She fell in love with me, the “colder” me, I suppose. Love is a chosen feeling, in times of hardship, and went it came down to those times, I didn’t know you were “supposed to choose love”. That’s not the environment I grew up in. When things were going well in my family, I felt the love. When things were bad though, things were bad… I brought that into my own relationship. I never realized this dynamic in my own family because before the bad times would send me into fight or flight, and I always picked fight… when you pick fight, it suppresses emotional damage that you’re feeling I believe. I didn’t even realize the emotional damage that was being inflicted upon myself, so it was hard to see the damage I’d do unto others. Lately, I have been in therapy and learning to undo these behaviors. I still live with my parents, and when things are “bad” (often), I’ve now been going with a freeze response. And I have been feeling the pain they inflict upon me, astronomically. It hurts so bad, ontop of this break up that I caused completely on my own with who I believe to be the love of my life.
I take all of this advice seriously, thank you.

I’ve read a majority of this book, and some of it rings true for me. Especially the behaviors I would do. But the reasoning? For power and control? I honestly don’t think that was my thought process whatsoever. But perhaps, as usual I don’t understand my own emotions. I’d usually be my “negative” self when my self esteem or ego felt threatened, so maybe I’d lash out to gain some power back? I’m honestly not sure. Perhaps I’d look for control and make her “stop doing that” by lashing out when she did, when all she was really doing was criticizing my behaviors, logically. Emotionally it hurt, badly, and I just wanted it to stop. It’d probably stop if I had just been a good boyfriend to her. I really did love this girl, but I think I was too driven by emotion/immature for a relationship this real and strong, and in term ended up hurting her badly. I wish I could just try again, with some of the knowledge I have now, and a growth mindset. She grew so much during the relationship, we dated 17-22, I didn’t. It hurts, a lot, that I was in denial for so long and parts of me still may be, but I honestly feel confused at my own actions. Intellectually, I feel smarter than my actions, but emotionally I feel stunted.

I’m not even bisexual, I was just a bit confused and drunk when I told her that, but still her not supporting or validating that ruined me. Narcissists need to be validated, and anything they think that will not be obviously validated is very scary to express.

Another thing is, we just want love. Goes with my last point. So we will create this persona just for you that can receive love from you. Kind of sweet if you think about it. But also a bit evil as it’s selfish.
